purpose: Qualify whether Claude Code 2.1.247 can produce an auditable claude-opus-5-only structured response without advisor, fallback, subagent, MCP, parent-tool or server-tool activity.

sandbox.runtime: private 0700 host temporary directory, writable only at /run/claude-purity inside the sandbox, deleted after use
sandbox.authentication: copy exactly one ordinary 0600 first-party OAuth credential file into the ephemeral CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; do not expose any other host HOME content or credential environment variable

acceptance.event_order: exactly one init first; only known rate-limit/thinking telemetry before a contiguous assistant block; exactly one receipt immediately after the final assistant; exactly one success result last
acceptance.telemetry_object_policy: Every known event and route-critical nested telemetry object is checked against a frozen allowed-key set; unknown result, init, assistant, receipt, usage, iteration, modelUsage, cache, rate-limit or content-block fields are invalid.
acceptance.normalized_alias_policy: Envelope keys and type values are normalized across case, snake_case, camelCase and punctuation. Model/provider aliases must carry exact expected values; prompt-suggestion, parent-tool alias, subagent-id, tool, MCP, computer-use and web-search/fetch suffix families are invalid.

parse_lineage: CALL, PREFLIGHT, FROZEN-HASHES, RAW.stdout and RAW.stderr must be ordinary non-symlink files. CALL has an exact field set and must match the committed package blobs, immutable PREFLIGHT, frozen request/input/prompt/schema hashes, Claude binary hash, displayed argument contract and both RAW hashes before a candidate can be written.
outbound_policy: Only PROMPT.md, neutral INPUT.json and SCHEMA.json bytes may be sent. The scanner rejects credentials, generic Unix absolute paths, Windows drive-root paths, bare R/P numeric experiment IDs, real experiment identifiers and model/provider provenance. URI schemes such as https:// are removed only for path detection so legitimate schema URLs are not misclassified.
interpretation: A PASS qualifies only this exact CLI/version/flags/environment contract for later primary-lead consideration. It is not a model-quality score and does not retroactively validate any mixed-model response.
